flows.title: Create a course and publish it
steps: From your Dashboard, click Create new product in the top-right corner. This opens the course creation wizard.
Enter the course title and the author, and a description if you want one.
Add a thumbnail image. The aspect ratio is 16:9 and the recommended size is 1024 × 576 px.
In the step that outlines the course, choose how to build the curriculum: Generate with AI, Start from scratch, Bulk upload, or Copy from another course.
In the Course Setup Guide, check the curriculum under Curriculum Preview.
Choose the sales page students enrol from — the course sales page, the product details page, or an external URL — and choose the thank-you page they land on afterwards.

flows.title: Add a section and a lesson to a course
steps: From your Teachable admin area, click Courses and go to the course you want.
Click Curriculum in the course admin sidebar to open the Curriculum tab.
Click the New Section button at the bottom of the page.
Add a Section Name, then click Save. The new section is placed underneath an existing section.
To put a section between two existing ones instead, hover between the section blocks and click the New section button there.
Click the New lesson button inside the section you want the lesson in.
Enter a Lesson Name, then click Save. New lessons are unpublished until you publish them.
